Dana: Thanks for the Q&A during today's all-hands. Dropping a compact follow-up for reliability + RCA link.
Dana: RCA: https://docs.redwood.ai/rca/2026-03-incident-237. TL;DR at the top, please review.
Mohan: Thx. Can leadership clarify if we should push the long-term fix timeline into the roadmap or keep it as an ops-only item?
Dana: Exec ask was to include a roadmap entry for a permanent router fix and SLA improvements. PM will own the roadmap ticket.
Priya: Runtime is shipping a patch as mitigation; longer term we need a router redesign doc. I'll create the roadmap ticket and tag PMs.
Elena: Obs follow-up: RED-7123 needs token-level traces + sequence length histogram. I can deliver sampling by EOD.
Rory: Runtime hotfix ETA 03/24 10:00 PT. I'll link the PR here once CI passes.
Sam: Ops verification plan: smoke run + 30m soak on canary. I'll run `./scripts/smoke-check --model gpt-redwood-v1` once PR is merged.
Claire: I'll consolidate the customer-facing note and the status page update. Draft ready in ~30m and will post for review.
incident-bot: incident-237 postmortem published -> https://incidents.redwood.ai/237
Mohan: Suggest we add a measurable SLO remediation target in the roadmap entry so PMs have a quantifiable goal.
Dana: Agreed. Priya, can you create the roadmap ticket and add P0/P1 mapping from the RCA? Mark owners.
Priya: On it. Ticket will be RED-7201 and I9ll paste the link here.
Elena: RED-7123 updated with trace samples and a small checklist.
Rory: PR: https://git.redwood.ai/r/runtime/pulls/428 (WIP) - will update status here when CI green.
Sam: After PR lands I9ll run smoke + soak and post metrics snapshots (p50/p95/p99) in this thread.
Dana: Thanks all. I'll summarize final action items and drop a short exec note after Claire posts the comms draft. Keep replies tight in this thread.
